meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理生物序列、解析文件、访问NCBI数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理FASTA/GenBank文件或需要批量查询NCBI。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate biological sequences, parse files, and access NCBI databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with FASTA/GenBank files or need batch NCBI queries.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Biopython 处理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列，读写 FASTA、GenBank 等文件，访问 NCBI 数据库，运行 BLAST 搜索，分析蛋白质结构，构建进化树，计算序列统计量等。
howto.when: 当你要求处理生物序列、文件格式转换、数据库查询、BLAST 搜索、序列比对、蛋白质结构分析或进化树构建时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Biopython 从 FASTA 文件读取序列并计算 GC 含量。
用 Biopython 对两条序列做全局比对并显示得分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Biopython to manipulate DNA/RNA/protein sequences, read/write FASTA/GenBank files, access NCBI databases, run BLAST searches, analyze protein structures, build phylogenetic trees, and compute sequence statistics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process biological sequences, convert file formats, query databases, run BLAST, align sequences, analyze protein structures, or build phylogenetic trees.

say_en.text: Use Biopython to read sequences from a FASTA file and calculate GC content.
Search PubMed for CRISPR literature using Entrez, return top 5 results.
say_en.note: Claude will call Bio.Entrez to search and display results.

say_en.text: Perform a global pairwise alignment of two sequences and show the score.
say_en.note: Claude will use Bio.Align to align and output the result.
